# Scaleezy

> Scaleezy is an operating system for apparel commerce built for Indian boutiques, saree stores, fashion retailers and apparel brands. It connects inventory, billing and POS, CRM, marketing, virtual try-on, analytics and logistics on one data layer.

Scaleezy publishes practical, plain-language guides for boutique owners on inventory, GST billing, customer retention, WhatsApp marketing, virtual try-on and multi-store operations. Content is written for Indian fashion retail and uses rupee examples.

## Product

- [Modules overview](https://scaleezy.com/modules): Inventory, CRM, Boutique storefront, POS, Tryon2buy virtual try-on, Marketing, Analytics, Billing Desk, Logistics
- [How it works](https://scaleezy.com/how-it-works)
- [Solutions by business type](https://scaleezy.com/solutions)
- [Pricing](https://scaleezy.com/#pricing): single boutique from ₹2,499/month, multi-store growth plan ₹5,999/month, enterprise custom; 14-day free trial
- [Request access](https://scaleezy.com/request-access)
